headline.bm: MB Negeri Sembilan Ismail Lasim letak jawatan (Istana kata perkenan diraja masih diperlukan) manakala Anwar menolak rombakan Kabinet; Macron berada di Malaysia dan Iran mendakwa kapal tangki keempat terkena periuk api berhampiran Hormuz. Pertemuan Trump-Xi-Putin pada 19 Nov dan IPO Anthropic (harga ditetapkan 18 Nov) kekal berita global utama.
headline.en: Negeri Sembilan MB Ismail Lasim resigns (Palace says royal assent still needed) as Anwar rules out a reshuffle; Macron is in Malaysia and Iran says a fourth tanker hit a mine near Hormuz. The 19 Nov Trump-Xi-Putin summit and Anthropic's IPO (pricing 18 Nov) remain the top global stories.

summary.bm: Presiden Perancis Emmanuel Macron tiba di Malaysia pada 17 Nov untuk lawatan rasmi dua hari, lawatan pertama oleh seorang presiden Perancis. Anwar pulang dari sidang kemuncak ASEAN di Manila untuk menyambut beliau.
summary.en: French President Emmanuel Macron arrived in Malaysia on 17 Nov for a two-day official visit, the first by a French president. Anwar returned from the ASEAN summit in Manila to host him.

title.bm: Macron mendarat di Malaysia dalam lawatan pertama sebagai Presiden Perancis; rundingan dengan Anwar hari ini
title.en: Macron lands in Malaysia for first visit as French president; talks with Anwar today

why.bm: Perkongsian Strategik boleh memperdalam kerjasama pertahanan, pendidikan dan tenaga bersih dengan sebuah kuasa EU.
why.en: A Strategic Partnership could deepen defence, education and clean-energy links with an EU power.

summary.bm: Hari kedua Sidang Kemuncak ASEAN ke-49 di Manila: Anwar menghadiri sidang ASEAN-China, ASEAN-PBB, ASEAN-Australia dan ASEAN-Korea Selatan, bertemu Laos dan mengadakan sidang akhbar jam 4 petang, kemudian pulang menyambut Macron. Beliau kembali ke Manila pada 17 Nov untuk penutup dan sidang ASEAN-AS yang turut dihadiri Trump; kerusi ASEAN berpindah daripada Filipina kepada Singapura untuk 2027. Setiausaha Luar Filipina berkata kira-kira 80% draf Tatakelakuan Laut China Selatan dipersetujui sementara, namun rundingan berlarutan hingga 2027.
summary.en: Day two of the 49th ASEAN Summit in Manila: Anwar attends the ASEAN-China, ASEAN-UN, ASEAN-Australia and ASEAN-Korea summits, meets Laos and holds a 4pm press conference, then flies home to welcome Macron. He returns to Manila on 17 Nov for the closing and the ASEAN-US summit, which Trump will attend; the chair passes from the Philippines to Singapore for 2027. The Philippines' foreign secretary says about 80% of the South China Sea Code of Conduct draft is provisionally agreed, but talks will run into 2027.

title.bm: Sidang Kemuncak ASEAN ke-49 dibuka di Manila dengan perang dan Laut China Selatan dalam agenda
title.en: 49th ASEAN Summit opens in Manila with wars and the South China Sea on the agenda

why.bm: Pembabitan diplomatik utama Malaysia minggu ini; nada perdagangan dan keselamatan terhadap AS dan China penting untuk eksport.
why.en: Malaysia's main diplomatic engagement this week; trade and security tone toward US and China matters for exports.

summary.bm: Bercakap di Manila di sebalik Sidang Kemuncak ASEAN, Anwar berkata hubungan Malaysia dengan Washington tidak akan menghadkan hubungan dengan Beijing. Beliau berulang-alik antara Manila dan Kuala Lumpur kerana sidang tersebut bertembung dengan lawatan Macron.
summary.en: Speaking in Manila on the sidelines of the ASEAN summit, Anwar said Malaysia's ties with Washington will not restrict its engagement with Beijing. He is shuttling between Manila and Kuala Lumpur as the summit meetings coincide with Macron's visit.

title.bm: Anwar di Manila: Malaysia tidak akan benarkan hubungan dengan AS menghadkan hubungan dengan China
title.en: Anwar in Manila: Malaysia won't let US ties limit its engagement with China

why.bm: Menandakan pendirian seimbang Malaysia menjelang sidang ASEAN-AS dan pertemuan Trump-Xi-Putin; penting untuk perdagangan dan eksport.
why.en: Signals Malaysia's balanced stance ahead of the ASEAN-US summit and the Trump-Xi-Putin meeting; matters for trade and exports.

summary.bm: BN dan PN meraih majoriti dua pertiga di Melaka (kiraan tidak rasmi The Edge: BN 21, PN 3, PH 4 daripada 28 kerusi; angka BN berbeza sedikit antara media). PKR dan Amanah tidak menang sebarang kerusi, hanya empat milik DAP, manakala PAS naik daripada satu kepada dua kerusi; keluar mengundi sekitar 71%.
summary.en: BN and PN took a two-thirds majority in Melaka (The Edge unofficial tally: BN 21, PN 3, PH 4 of 28; BN figures differ slightly between outlets). PKR and Amanah won no seats, only DAP's four, while PAS rose from one seat to two; turnout was about 71%.

title.bm: Ab Rauf mengangkat sumpah penggal kedua Ketua Menteri Melaka selepas kemenangan besar BN-PN
title.en: Ab Rauf sworn in for a second term as Melaka chief minister after BN-PN landslide

why.bm: Ujian negeri pertama bagi landskap PRU16 dan kemunduran buat PH, sebahagiannya berkaitan isu Najib.
why.en: First state test of GE16 battle lines and a setback for PH, partly over the Najib issue.

summary.bm: Setiausaha Agung DAP Anthony Loke berkata selagi Perdana Menteri mendapat sokongan majoriti Dewan Rakyat, tiada sebab untuk beliau tunduk kepada tekanan, dan kerajaan masih ada kira-kira setahun untuk agenda reformasi. Beliau menambah pembubaran Parlimen adalah kuasa Yang di-Pertuan Agong atas nasihat PM, dan pemimpin PH kekal bersatu di belakang Anwar.
summary.en: DAP's Anthony Loke said that as long as the PM commands a Dewan Rakyat majority there is no reason to yield, and that the government has about a year left for reforms. He added that dissolution is the Agong's power on the PM's advice and PH leaders remain united behind Anwar.

title.bm: Loke: Anwar tidak perlu tunduk kepada gesaan bubar Parlimen awal
title.en: Loke: Anwar need not bow to calls for early dissolution of Parliament

why.bm: Petanda kerajaan perpaduan mahu menamatkan penggal walaupun kalah di Melaka dan ada ketegangan dalam Kabinet.
why.en: Signals the unity government intends to run its term despite the Melaka loss and cabinet strain.

summary.bm: Di bawah Belanjawan 2027 gaji minimum naik daripada RM1,700 kepada RM2,000; firma dengan jualan di bawah RM50 juta dikecualikan. Gaji sara hidup GLC naik daripada RM3,100 kepada RM3,400 (kira-kira 230,000 pekerja).
summary.en: Under Budget 2027 the minimum wage goes from RM1,700 to RM2,000; firms with sales under RM50m are exempt. The GLC living wage rises from RM3,100 to RM3,400 (about 230,000 workers).

title.bm: Gaji minimum naik kepada RM2,000 mulai Jun 2027
title.en: Minimum wage to rise to RM2,000 from June 2027

why.bm: Menjejaskan kos upah dan kos sara hidup.
why.en: Affects wage costs and the cost of living.

summary.bm: Seorang pegawai kanan PBB menggesa kargo baja dibenarkan melalui Hormuz; harga baja naik 30% sejak sekatan bermula dan kegagalan menanam boleh menyebabkan 45 juta orang berdepan kekurangan makanan teruk. Tentera laut Iran berkata tujuh kapal tangki terkena periuk api dalam 24 jam dan mengaitkan pembukaan semula dengan penamatan sekatan AS.
summary.en: A senior UN official urged fertiliser cargoes be allowed through Hormuz; fertiliser prices are up 30% since the blockades began and missed planting could leave 45 million people facing severe food insecurity. Iran's navy says seven tankers hit mines within 24 hours and ties reopening to an end to the US blockade.

title.bm: PBB gesa koridor Hormuz terhad masa untuk kapal baja apabila harga naik 30%
title.en: UN urges time-bound Hormuz corridor for fertiliser ships as prices rise 30%

why.bm: Baja lebih mahal boleh menaikkan kos makanan dan input kelapa sawit di Asia, termasuk Malaysia.
why.en: Costlier fertiliser can push up food and palm oil input costs across Asia, including Malaysia.

summary.bm: Emas spot sekitar $3,888 pada Jumaat selepas menyentuh $3,852 pada Khamis, terendah sejak Okt 2025, turun lebih 4% seminggu. Indeks dolar hampir 103.18.
summary.en: Spot gold was about $3,888 on Friday after touching $3,852 on Thursday, the lowest since Oct 2025, down more than 4% on the week. The dollar index was near 103.18.

title.bm: Emas catat minggu terburuk dalam empat bulan ketika jangkaan kenaikan Fed dan dolar menekan
title.en: Gold has its worst week in four months as Fed-hike bets and dollar weigh

why.bm: Jangkaan Fed lebih tegas menekan emas dan ringgit.
why.en: Hawkish Fed expectations weigh on gold and the ringgit.

summary.bm: Brent (Jan) ditutup $95.84 dan WTI $88.56 pada 13 Nov, kerugian mingguan kedua, ketika sekatan AS ke atas Iran berterusan. IEA menjangka lebihan bekalan 1.7 juta tong sehari pada suku keempat dan OPEC+ mengepam 41.23 juta tong sehari pada Oktober.
summary.en: Brent (Jan) settled at $95.84 and WTI at $88.56 on 13 Nov, a second weekly loss, while the US blockade of Iran continues. The IEA sees a Q4 surplus of 1.7m bpd and OPEC+ pumped 41.23m bpd in October.

title.bm: Minyak menuju penurunan mingguan kedua dekat $95 apabila Trump kekalkan sekatan Iran
title.en: Oil heads for a second weekly fall near $95 as Trump keeps the Iran blockade

why.bm: Minyak hampir $95 masih menekan harga bahan api, subsidi dan inflasi di Malaysia.
why.en: Oil near $95 still feeds fuel, subsidy and inflation pressure in Malaysia.

summary.bm: Hasil Perbendaharaan 10 tahun naik ke sekitar 5.15% (naik kira-kira 30 mata asas seminggu) dan indeks dolar ke 103.41, tertinggi sejak April 2025. Niaga hadapan sepenuhnya menjangka kenaikan kadar pada FOMC 8-9 Dis.
summary.en: The 10-year Treasury yield rose to about 5.15% (up roughly 30bp on the week) and the dollar index to 103.41, its highest since April 2025. Futures fully price a rate hike at the 8-9 Dec FOMC.

title.bm: Dolar hampir paras tertinggi 19 bulan apabila pedagang meramal kenaikan kadar Fed; hasil 10 tahun 5.14%
title.en: Dollar near 19-month high as traders price possible Fed hike; 10-year yield at 5.14%

why.bm: Dolar lebih kukuh dan hasil lebih tinggi menekan ringgit dan Bursa serta menaikkan kos import.
why.en: A stronger dollar and higher yields weigh on the ringgit and Bursa and raise import costs.

summary.bm: S&P 500 ditutup 7,561.67 (-0.40%) dan Nasdaq jatuh 0.91%; AMD merosot 8.75% dan Nvidia 2% selepas peletakan jawatan CEOnya dan penurunan taraf. Seminggu, S&P naik 2.51%, Dow 2.07% dan Nasdaq 2.27%.
summary.en: The S&P 500 closed at 7,561.67 (-0.40%) and the Nasdaq fell 0.91%; AMD dropped 8.75% and Nvidia 2% after its CEO's resignation and a downgrade. For the week the S&P rose 2.51%, the Dow 2.07% and the Nasdaq 2.27%.

title.bm: Wall Street ditutup lebih rendah Jumaat akibat jualan cip, tetapi S&P 500 naik 2.5% seminggu
title.en: Wall Street ends Friday lower on chip selloff, but S&P 500 gains 2.5% on the week

why.bm: Kegoyahan sektor cip memberi kesan kepada saham teknologi Asia dan semikonduktor Malaysia.
why.en: Chip-sector volatility feeds into Asian tech and Malaysian semiconductor shares.

summary.bm: Pertumbuhan tahunan 1.9%. Timbalan Gabenor BoE Lombardelli berkata kejutan tenaga lebih lama daripada dijangka, menguatkan hujah kenaikan kadar lagi; sidang kemuncak UK-EU dijadual 20 Nov.
summary.en: Annual growth was 1.9%. BoE Deputy Governor Lombardelli said the energy shock has lasted longer than expected, strengthening the case for more hikes; a UK-EU summit is set for 20 Nov.

title.bm: KDNK UK suku ketiga naik 0.7%, terkukuh dalam lebih dua tahun, BoE beri amaran kejutan tenaga berpanjangan
title.en: UK Q3 GDP grows 0.7%, strongest in over two years, as BoE warns energy shock lasts longer

why.bm: Kadar tinggi lebih lama di ekonomi utama mengekalkan pembiayaan global ketat.
why.en: Higher-for-longer rates in major economies keep global financing tight.

summary.bm: Beijing mengecam penggunaan dakwaan "pengintipan" Nvidia oleh AS untuk mempertahankan sekatan teknologi, merumitkan pertemuan Xi-Trump minggu depan. Gencatan setahun itu tamat pada Januari. Senator Demokrat meminta rekod eksport Nvidia dipelihara.
summary.en: Beijing denounced US use of Nvidia "spying" claims to defend tech curbs, complicating next week's Xi-Trump meeting. The year-long truce expires in January. Democratic senators asked the administration to preserve Nvidia export records.

title.bm: Pertikaian Nvidia menguji gencatan dagang AS-China menjelang kunjungan Trump ke Xi minggu depan
title.en: Nvidia row tests US-China trade truce as Xi set to welcome Trump next week

why.bm: Kegagalan rundingan boleh menjejaskan rantaian bekalan cip dan sektor semikonduktor Malaysia yang bergantung pada eksport.
why.en: A breakdown would hit chip supply chains and Malaysia's export-driven semiconductor sector.

summary.bm: FMT melaporkan lebihan dagangan China melonjak melepasi AS$1 trilion, didorong eksport berkaitan AI.
summary.en: FMT reports China's trade surplus surged past US$1tn, powered by AI-related exports.

title.bm: Lebihan dagangan China melepasi AS$1 trilion apabila ledakan AI menaikkan eksport
title.en: China's trade surplus passes US$1 trillion as AI boom lifts exports

why.bm: Meningkatkan risiko ketegangan dagangan menjelang sidang APEC dan memberi kesan kepada eksport elektronik Malaysia.
why.en: Raises trade-tension risk ahead of the APEC summit and affects Malaysia's electronics exports.

summary.bm: Laporan yang memetik Wall Street Journal menyatakan AS hilang status penghapusan campak selepas penularan berterusan; ABC melaporkan kes seluruh negara melebihi 5,400 dengan 10 kematian. CDC merekodkan 5,412 kes disahkan setakat 13 Nov, naik 230 seminggu.
summary.en: Reports citing the Wall Street Journal say the US lost its measles elimination status after continued spread; ABC reports nationwide cases above 5,400 with 10 deaths. The CDC counted 5,412 confirmed cases by 13 Nov, up 230 in a week.

title.bm: AS dilaporkan hilang status penghapusan campak apabila kes melebihi 5,400
title.en: US reported to lose measles elimination status as cases top 5,400

why.bm: Semak vaksin MMR anak sebelum melancong ke AS.
why.en: Check children's MMR vaccination before travelling to the US.

summary.bm: Setakat 12 Nov terdapat 11,197 kes disahkan dan 5,471 kematian di lapan wilayah DRC, menurut ECDC; Ituri sahaja mencatat 7,485 kes. Tiada vaksin atau rawatan diluluskan, ujian vaksin bermula di Bunia pada 23 Okt, dan ECDC menilai risiko kepada penduduk EU/EEA sangat rendah.
summary.en: As of 12 Nov there are 11,197 confirmed cases and 5,471 deaths across eight DRC provinces, per ECDC; Ituri alone has 7,485 cases. There is no approved vaccine or treatment, a vaccine trial started in Bunia on 23 Oct, and ECDC rates risk for EU/EEA residents as very low.

title.bm: Ebola (Bundibugyo): DRC melepasi 11,100 kes disahkan dan 5,400 kematian
title.en: Ebola (Bundibugyo): DRC passes 11,100 confirmed cases and 5,400 deaths

why.bm: WHO tidak menggalakkan larangan perjalanan; elakkan bersentuhan dengan pesakit dan dapatkan rawatan jika demam selepas pulang dari kawasan terjejas.
why.en: WHO advises against travel bans; avoid contact with the sick and seek care for fever after travel to affected areas.

summary.bm: Gardenia Malaysia Timur menjelaskan ia entiti berasingan daripada Gardenia KL selepas aduan membabitkan Original Classic White Bread dan Twiggies Choc-A-Lot. KKM menunggu keputusan makmal dan akan memeriksa kilang KL di bawah Akta Makanan 1983; nombor kelompok belum lengkap.
summary.en: Gardenia East Malaysia says it is separate from Gardenia KL after complaints involving Original Classic White Bread and Twiggies Choc-A-Lot. The Health Ministry awaits lab results and will inspect the KL factory under the Food Act 1983; batch numbers are incomplete.

title.bm: Malaysia: KKM siasat dakwaan sakit selepas makan produk Gardenia
title.en: Malaysia: KKM probes illness claims linked to Gardenia bread and snacks

why.bm: Nota keselamatan: simpan bungkusan dan lapor gejala kepada KKM; tiada penarikan balik diumumkan.
why.en: Safety note: keep the packaging and report symptoms to KKM; no recall announced.

summary.bm: Dua kes disahkan klade 1 dan dua lagi disyaki menunggu analisis; tiga pesakit berkata mereka tidak keluar dari daerah itu setahun lalu. Klade 1 mempunyai kadar kematian dilaporkan 1% hingga 10%, berbanding 1% hingga 4% bagi klade 2.
summary.en: Two cases are confirmed clade 1 and two are suspected pending analysis; three patients say they did not leave the county in the past year. Clade 1 has a reported fatality rate of 1% to 10%, versus 1% to 4% for clade 2.

title.bm: California siasat empat kes mpox klade 1 di Stanislaus County, tiga tanpa sejarah perjalanan
title.en: California investigates four clade 1 mpox cases in Stanislaus County, three with no travel

why.bm: Penularan tempatan menunjukkan jangkitan tidak dikesan; elak sentuhan rapat dengan orang berruam dan dapatkan rawatan awal jika bergejala.
why.en: Local spread suggests undetected transmission; avoid close contact with anyone with a rash and seek care early if symptoms appear.

summary.bm: ChAdOx1 Oxford/Serum Institute dan mRNA-1469 Moderna akan menyertai ujian Tumaini yang bermula 23 Okt di Bunia dengan vaksinasi cincin. WHO merekodkan lebih 10,500 kes dan 5,126 kematian setakat 1 Nov.
summary.en: Oxford/Serum Institute ChAdOx1 and Moderna mRNA-1469 will join the Tumaini trial, which began Oct 23 in Bunia with ring vaccination. WHO counted over 10,500 cases and 5,126 deaths as of Nov 1.

title.bm: WHO tambah dua calon vaksin khusus Bundibugyo ke ujian Ebola DRC
title.en: WHO adds two Bundibugyo-specific vaccine candidates to DRC Ebola trial

why.bm: Pelancong ke kawasan terjejas patut mengikut nasihat KKM dan WHO.
why.en: Travellers to affected areas should follow KKM and WHO advisories.

summary.bm: IRGC mendakwa enam dron menyerang radar pertahanan udara AS di Pangkalan Udara Riffa, serangan kedua dituntut di situ dalam tiga hari; Bahrain membunyikan dua amaran berselang kira-kira tiga jam dan berkata ia menyekat beberapa serangan udara Iran. CENTCOM belum mengulas dakwaan terkini; pada 13 Nov ia berkata menembak jatuh dua dron IRGC tanpa kerosakan.
summary.en: The IRGC says six drones hit a US air-defence radar at Riffa Air Base, its second claimed strike there in three days; Bahrain sounded two alerts about three hours apart and said it blocked several Iranian aerial attacks. CENTCOM had not commented on the latest claim; on 13 Nov it said it shot down two IRGC drones with no damage.

title.bm: Pengawal Revolusi Iran dakwa serang pangkalan AS di Bahrain; Bahrain keluarkan amaran seluruh negara
title.en: Iran's Guards claim drone strike on US base in Bahrain; Bahrain issues nationwide alert

why.bm: Serangan yang meluas di Teluk mengekalkan risiko minyak, tambang kargo dan kos bahan api Malaysia; semua dakwaan serangan belum disahkan.
why.en: Widening Gulf attacks keep oil, freight and Malaysian fuel-cost risks high; all attack claims are unverified.

summary.bm: Tentera laut Iran berkata kapal tangki minyak keempat terkena periuk api laut dan terbakar di timur Selat Hormuz, menambah dakwaan terdahulu mengenai kapal tangki terkena periuk api. Dakwaan ini datang daripada sumber tentera Iran dan belum disahkan secara bebas.
summary.en: Iran's army navy said a fourth oil tanker struck a naval mine and caught fire east of the Strait of Hormuz, adding to earlier claims of tankers hit by mines. The claims come from Iranian military sources and are not independently confirmed.

title.bm: Iran: kapal tangki keempat terkena periuk api dan terbakar di timur Hormuz
title.en: Iran says a fourth tanker hit a mine and caught fire east of Hormuz

why.bm: Serangan berulang terhadap perkapalan mengekalkan risiko harga minyak serta kos bahan api dan kargo Malaysia; dakwaan ini daripada sumber negara Iran.
why.en: Repeated hits on shipping keep oil prices and Malaysian fuel and freight costs exposed; claims come from Iranian state sources.

summary.bm: Sumber Reuters berkata Trump mungkin menahan serangan baharu kecuali diprovokasi, manakala Yahoo melaporkan beliau mengalihkan Naib Presiden Vance daripada rundingan Iran dan perjanjian bukan lagi keutamaan. Ketua perunding Iran, Ghalibaf, berkata Tehran menghantar tujuh syarat melalui orang tengah Qatar, termasuk menamatkan sekatan laut dan sekatan ekonomi serta mengisytiharkan perang tamat secara rasmi.
summary.en: Reuters sources said Trump may hold off new strikes unless provoked, while Yahoo says he moved Vice President Vance off the Iran talks and that a deal is no longer a priority. Iran's chief negotiator Ghalibaf says Tehran sent seven conditions via a Qatari mediator, including lifting the naval blockade and sanctions and formally declaring the war over.

title.bm: Trump mungkin tangguh serangan baharu ke atas Iran; Vance diketepikan daripada rundingan ketika Iran hantar tujuh syarat melalui Qatar
title.en: Trump may hold off new Iran strikes; Vance sidelined from talks as Iran sends seven conditions via Qatar

why.bm: Jeda boleh meredakan risiko Hormuz dan minyak ke atas kos bahan api dan kargo Malaysia, tetapi isyarat ini belum disahkan dan boleh berubah.
why.en: A pause would ease Hormuz and oil risk for Malaysia's fuel and freight costs, but the signal is unconfirmed and reversible.

summary.bm: Zelenskiy berkata utusan AS Witkoff dan Kushner bertanya sama ada Ukraine akan berundur dari Donbas sebagai ganti keahlian NATO; AS belum mengesahkannya secara jelas. Beliau menolak menyerahkan wilayah, hanya mempertimbangkan referendum dengan jaminan keselamatan, dan Rusia, yang menguasai kira-kira 88% Donbas, menganggap keahlian NATO garis merah.
summary.en: Zelenskiy said US envoys Witkoff and Kushner asked whether Ukraine would withdraw from Donbas in exchange for NATO membership; the US has not explicitly confirmed it. He rules out ceding territory, would consider a referendum only with security guarantees, and Russia, which holds about 88% of Donbas, treats NATO membership as a red line.

title.bm: Zelenskiy: AS cadang Ukraine tinggalkan Donbas sebagai ganti keahlian NATO
title.en: Zelenskiy: US floated Ukraine leaving Donbas in exchange for NATO membership

why.bm: Kali pertama rundingan mengaitkan NATO dengan wilayah; hasilnya membentuk keselamatan Eropah dan harga tenaga.
why.en: First time talks link NATO to territory; the outcome shapes European security and energy prices.

summary.bm: Pemimpin bersetuju dengan laluan bersyarat untuk 'pemulihan beransur-ansur' perwakilan Myanmar jika ada kemajuan dalam Konsensus Lima Perkara; Min Aung Hlaing sekali lagi tidak dijemput. ASEAN dan China bersetuju secara sementara kira-kira 80% kod tatakelakuan, tetapi tiga daripada empat isu utama kekal, termasuk sifat mengikat di sisi undang-undang, dan rundingan beralih ke Singapura pada 2027.
summary.en: Leaders agreed a conditional path for 'gradual restoration' of Myanmar's representation if it progresses on the Five-Point Consensus; Min Aung Hlaing was again excluded. ASEAN and China have provisionally agreed about 80% of the code of conduct, but three of four sticking points remain, including legal bindingness, and talks pass to Singapore in 2027.

title.bm: ASEAN Hari 1: laluan bersyarat untuk Myanmar, tarikh akhir kod tatakelakuan Laut China Selatan terlepas
title.en: ASEAN Day 1: conditional path back for Myanmar, South China Sea code of conduct deadline missed

why.bm: Malaysia ialah penuntut Laut China Selatan, maka kod yang tertangguh membiarkan risiko maritim tidak selesai.
why.en: Malaysia is a South China Sea claimant, so a delayed code leaves maritime risk unresolved.

summary.bm: Jurucakap Saudi berkata pertahanan udara memusnahkan dua peluru berpandu balistik ke arah Riyadh dan dua dron di Wilayah Timur; pegawai Houthi menyalahkan Arab Saudi atas serangan udara di Sanaa yang mencederakan empat orang awam dan mendakwa menjatuhkan pesawat peninjau Saudi. AP menyatakan ini berlaku selepas gencatan lebih empat tahun.
summary.en: A Saudi spokesman said air defences destroyed two ballistic missiles fired toward Riyadh and two drones over the Eastern Region; Houthi officials blamed Saudi Arabia for an airstrike on Sanaa that wounded four civilians and claimed they downed a Saudi reconnaissance aircraft. AP says this follows more than four years of ceasefire.

title.bm: Arab Saudi: peluru berpandu dan dron Houthi ditembak jatuh, menamatkan tempoh gencatan lebih empat tahun
title.en: Saudi Arabia says it downed Houthi missiles and drones, ending a ceasefire lull of over four years

why.bm: Meluaskan konflik Teluk dan menambah risiko kepada perkapalan Laut Merah serta harga minyak.
why.en: Widens the Gulf conflict and adds risk to Red Sea shipping and oil prices.

summary.bm: Gedung Putih dan Kremlin mengesahkan pertemuan tiga hala pertama pada Khamis 19 Nov di sisi APEC di Shenzhen; Trump mahu membincangkan pengurangan senjata nuklear dan perang Iran. Pegawai berkata Ukraine di landasan berasingan dan kawalan eksport cip tidak termasuk; Trump turut mengadakan makan tengah hari dua hala dengan Xi.
summary.en: The White House and Kremlin confirmed the first three-way meeting for Thu 19 Nov on the APEC sidelines in Shenzhen; Trump wants to discuss nuclear arms cuts and the Iran war. Officials say Ukraine is on a separate track and chip export controls are excluded; Trump also holds a bilateral lunch with Xi.

title.bm: Trump, Xi dan Putin akan mengadakan sidang kemuncak tiga hala pertama di APEC Shenzhen pada 19 Nov
title.en: Trump, Xi and Putin to hold first three-way summit at APEC in Shenzhen on Nov 19

why.bm: Hubungan AS-China-Rusia mempengaruhi perdagangan, tarif serta perang Ukraine dan Iran, termasuk prospek eksport Malaysia.
why.en: US-China-Russia ties shape trade, tariffs and the Ukraine and Iran wars, and Malaysia's export outlook.

summary.bm: Anthropic menjangka menetapkan harga akhir saham pada 18 Nov dan mula didagangkan 19 Nov di bawah simbol ANT; tempahan dilaporkan sekitar enam kali ganda saham ditawarkan. Julat awal ialah $70-$78 sesaham. Satu analisis pasaran pihak ketiga (Mitrade) menyebut tawaran 825 juta saham pada $70-$78, sehingga kira-kira $64.4 bilion dikutip, dengan Nvidia dilaporkan turun sekitar 32% daripada puncak Oktober; angka seperti dilaporkan, bukan disahkan syarikat.
summary.en: Anthropic expects to set its final share price on 18 Nov and begin trading on 19 Nov under ticker ANT; orders are reportedly about six times the shares offered. The earlier range was $70-$78 per share. A third-party market analysis (Mitrade) puts the offer at 825 million shares at $70-$78, up to about $64.4bn raised, with Nvidia reported down about 32% from its October peak; figures are as reported, not company-confirmed.

title.bm: IPO Anthropic mengikut jadual: penetapan harga 18 Nov, mula didagangkan di Nasdaq 19 Nov sebagai 'ANT', dilaporkan lebih langganan sekitar 6 kali
title.en: Anthropic IPO on track: pricing 18 Nov, Nasdaq debut 19 Nov as 'ANT', reportedly about 6x oversubscribed

why.bm: Julat ini sebelum penetapan harga; semak semula 18-19 Nov.
why.en: The range is pre-pricing; re-check on Nov 18-19.

summary.bm: Gemini 4 Hydrogen tersedia dalam AI Studio, API Gemini, aplikasi Gemini dan Carian, berharga $1.50 sejuta token input dan $7.50 sejuta token output dengan konteks 1 juta token. Google mendakwa ia hampir setara Carbon pada Terminal-Bench 4.0 dengan penggunaan kuota 24% lebih rendah (angka syarikat).
summary.en: Gemini 4 Hydrogen is available in AI Studio, the Gemini API, the Gemini app and Search, priced at $1.50 per million input and $7.50 per million output tokens with a 1M-token context. Google says it nears Carbon on Terminal-Bench 4.0 with 24% less quota use (company figures).

title.bm: Google lancarkan Gemini 4 Hydrogen merentasi API, aplikasi dan Carian
title.en: Google releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen across API, app and Search

why.bm: Peringkat Gemini yang lebih murah meningkatkan tekanan harga ke atas API AI pesaing.
why.en: A cheaper Gemini tier raises price pressure on rival AI APIs.

summary.bm: Pelancaran terhad kepada pengguna ChatGPT Pro AS berumur 18+ dengan kad AS; pembelian ditokenkan dan memerlukan kelulusan Face ID atau cap jari. Had perbelanjaan dirancang tetapi belum aktif.
summary.en: Rollout is limited to US ChatGPT Pro users aged 18+ with US cards; purchases are tokenised and need Face ID or fingerprint approval. Spending limits are planned but not yet live.

title.bm: ChatGPT Wallet dilancarkan supaya ejen AI boleh membeli-belah dan membayar
title.en: ChatGPT Wallet launches so AI agents can shop and check out

why.bm: Belum tersedia di Malaysia; tunggu had perbelanjaan.
why.en: Not available in Malaysia for now; wait for spending limits.

summary.bm: Diumumkan pada acara Cyber at the Frontier, Red Team menggunakan agen AI untuk ujian penembusan aplikasi web dan mengesahkan kelemahan, manakala Defense Factory menyiasat dapatan dan merangka tampalan untuk semakan manusia. Tiada yang dikerahkan secara automatik.
summary.en: Announced at its Cyber at the Frontier event, Red Team uses AI agents to pentest web apps and confirm vulnerabilities, while Defense Factory investigates findings and drafts patches for human review. Nothing is auto-deployed.

title.bm: OpenAI dedahkan alat keselamatan Daybreak Red Team dan Defense Factory
title.en: OpenAI unveils Daybreak Red Team and Defense Factory security tools

why.bm: Penampalan dibantu AI boleh memendekkan masa pembaikan untuk pasukan IT dan rangkaian.
why.en: AI-assisted patching could shorten fix times for IT and network teams.

summary.bm: Syarikat boleh menjalankan perkhidmatan agen dalam awan atau premis sendiri, dengan hanya panggilan model dihantar ke Anthropic atau rakan awan; akses melalui permohonan.
summary.en: Companies can run the agent service in their own cloud or on-premises, with only model calls going to Anthropic or a cloud partner; access is by request.

title.bm: Anthropic tawar Claude Managed Agents dihoskan sendiri dalam beta persendirian
title.en: Anthropic offers self-hosted Claude Managed Agents in private beta

why.bm: Membantu firma terkawal menyimpan data dalam organisasi ketika menggunakan agen AI.
why.en: Helps regulated firms keep data in-house when adopting AI agents.

summary.bm: Fable 5.2 ialah model asas sama dengan Mythos 5.2 dengan perlindungan siber dan biologi lebih kuat, berharga $8/$40 per juta token ($16/$80 mod pantas). Anthropic masih menyifatkan Claude Opus 5.5 pilihan harian terbaik.
summary.en: Fable 5.2 is the same underlying model as Mythos 5.2 with stronger cyber and biology safeguards, priced at $8/$40 per million tokens ($16/$80 in fast mode). Anthropic still calls Claude Opus 5.5 its best daily driver.

title.bm: Anthropic lancar Claude Fable 5.2 untuk semua pengguna; Mythos 5.2 terhad kepada organisasi disahkan
title.en: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 to all users; Mythos 5.2 limited to vetted orgs

why.bm: Semak kos dan had penggunaan sebelum bertukar model.
why.en: Check cost and usage limits before switching models.

summary.bm: Satu kunci yang dikeluarkan Cursor kepada Fireworks AI terdedah dalam pelanggaran Fireworks; penyerang menyalin data dari baldi kongsi dan pada 29 Okt menanam sambungan Claude Code berniat jahat pada cache yang melayani pasaran Cursor, berpotensi menjangkiti sehingga 5,000 pengguna.
summary.en: A key Cursor issued to Fireworks AI was exposed in a Fireworks breach; the attacker copied data from a shared bucket and on 29 Oct planted a trojanized Claude Code extension on the cache serving Cursor's marketplace, potentially reaching up to 5,000 users.

title.bm: Kunci Fireworks AI dicuri membawa kepada pelanggaran Cursor dan sambungan Claude Code berniat jahat
title.en: Stolen Fireworks AI key led to Cursor breach and a trojanized Claude Code extension

why.bm: Pembangun: semak sambungan IDE yang dipasang dan tukar mana-mana kunci yang terdedah.
why.en: Developers: review installed IDE extensions and rotate any exposed keys.

summary.bm: Tampalan kecemasan membaiki kelemahan tahap tinggi yang dieksploitasi sejak akhir Oktober untuk akses root dan kegigihan. Berasingan, get laluan Check Point yang terdedah diserang melalui PHP2Shell yang memasang perisian pemadam data pada hos VMware ESXi.
summary.en: Emergency hotfixes fix a high-severity flaw exploited since late October for root access and persistence. Separately, vulnerable Check Point gateways were hit with PHP2Shell attacks that dropped data-wiping malware on VMware ESXi hosts.

title.bm: Check Point tampal sifar-hari get laluan yang dieksploitasi; pemadam ESXi dipasang melalui PHP2Shell
title.en: Check Point patches exploited gateway zero-day; ESXi wiper deployed via PHP2Shell

why.bm: Pentadbir rangkaian: pasang hotfix Check Point sekarang dan semak log get laluan serta ESXi.
why.en: Network admins: apply the Check Point hotfix now and review gateway and ESXi logs.

summary.bm: Tampalan meliputi NetScaler ADC dan Gateway, serta satu kelemahan kritikal berasingan pada NetScaler Console (CVE-2026-120869). Peranti hujung rangkaian seperti ini kerap disasarkan penyerang.
summary.en: Patches cover NetScaler ADC and Gateway, plus a separate critical NetScaler Console flaw (CVE-2026-120869). Network-edge gear like this is a frequent attack target.

title.bm: Citrix tampal 28 kelemahan NetScaler, sembilan kritikal
title.en: Citrix patches 28 NetScaler flaws, nine of them critical

why.bm: Pasukan rangkaian: kemas kini NetScaler ADC/Gateway/Console ke binaan dibaiki sekarang.
why.en: Network teams: update NetScaler ADC/Gateway/Console to the fixed builds now.

summary.bm: Tahap dinaikkan daripada Rendah ke Sederhana pada 4 Nov berikutan ketegangan geopolitik dan pendedahan pusat data; infrastruktur kritikal mesti mematuhi sembilan langkah termasuk pemantauan 24 jam dan MFA. Fahmi berkata tiada insiden membimbangkan disahkan semasa PRN Melaka.
summary.en: The level moved from Low to Medium on 4 Nov citing geopolitical tension and data-centre exposure; critical infrastructure must follow nine measures including 24-hour monitoring and MFA. Fahmi said no worrying incidents were confirmed during the Melaka polls.

title.bm: NACSA amaran amber selepas menaikkan tahap ancaman siber negara ke Sederhana
title.en: NACSA on amber alert after raising national cyber threat level to Medium

why.bm: Syarikat: tampal peranti sempadan dan kuatkuasa MFA; orang ramai: rujuk NACSA untuk maklumat rasmi.
why.en: Firms: patch edge devices and enforce MFA; public: rely on NACSA for official updates.

summary.bm: Apple melancarkan tvOS 27.2.1 pada 13 Nov dengan Siri AI untuk model Apple TV 4K lama. HomePod mini 2 masih tiada Siri AI pada kemas kini terkininya.
summary.en: Apple released tvOS 27.2.1 on 13 Nov with Siri AI for older Apple TV 4K models. HomePod mini 2 still lacks Siri AI on its latest update.

title.bm: tvOS 27.2.1 bawa Siri AI ke Apple TV 4K generasi kedua dan ketiga
title.en: tvOS 27.2.1 brings Siri AI to second- and third-generation Apple TV 4K

why.bm: Pemilik Apple TV 4K lama mendapat ciri Siri baharu tanpa perkakasan baharu.
why.en: Owners of older Apple TV 4K get the new Siri features without new hardware.

summary.bm: Notifikasi ancaman Apple 29 Okt dihantar kepada pengguna di 99 negara; menteri Thailand berkata amaran sahaja tidak membuktikan peranti dijejaskan dan tiada bukti kaitan dengan Pegasus. SecurityWeek turut menerangkan bagaimana Secure Exclaves Apple melindungi data kamera dan mikrofon.
summary.en: Apple's 29 Oct threat notifications went to users in 99 countries; Thailand's minister said alerts alone do not show a device was compromised and no evidence links it to Pegasus. SecurityWeek separately explained how Apple's Secure Exclaves protect camera and microphone data.

title.bm: Apple bertemu pegawai Thailand berhubung amaran perisian intip selepas notifikasi ancaman 29 Okt
title.en: Apple meets Thai officials over spyware alerts sent after its 29 Oct threat notifications

why.bm: Jika menerima amaran ancaman Apple, kemas kini iOS dan pertimbangkan Mod Lockdown.
why.en: If you receive an Apple threat alert, update iOS and consider Lockdown Mode.

summary.bm: Nasihat menyenaraikan kira-kira sembilan kelemahan dalam sembang kumpulan iMessage, pasangan Bluetooth dan AirPlay; Apple tidak menyatakan ada yang dieksploitasi.
summary.en: The advisory lists around nine vulnerabilities in iMessage group chat, Bluetooth pairing and AirPlay; Apple did not say any was exploited.

title.bm: Apple keluarkan pembaikan keselamatan iOS/macOS 27.2.1, serta iOS 26.7.3 dan 18.7.12 untuk peranti lama
title.en: Apple ships iOS/macOS 27.2.1 security fixes, plus iOS 26.7.3 and 18.7.12 for older devices

why.bm: Kemas kini melalui Settings > General > Software Update.
why.en: Update via Settings > General > Software Update.

summary.bm: Bermula iOS, iPadOS, macOS dan visionOS 27.3, fail dan foto yang dikongsi dengan 'sesiapa yang ada pautan' boleh diakses Apple untuk semakan, walaupun Advanced Data Protection dihidupkan. Pautan yang dikongsi hanya dengan individu tertentu dikecualikan, dan Apple boleh membuang kandungan atau melumpuhkan akaun, dengan keluaran awam dijangka pada Disember.
summary.en: From iOS, iPadOS, macOS and visionOS 27.3, files and photos shared with 'Anyone with the link' become accessible to Apple for review, even with Advanced Data Protection on. Links shared only with named people are excluded, and Apple may remove content or disable accounts, with public release expected in December.

title.bm: Apple akan semak pautan iCloud awam untuk kandungan berbahaya mulai iOS 27.3, menamatkan penyulitan hujung ke hujung bagi pautan itu
title.en: Apple will review public iCloud links for harmful content from iOS 27.3, ending end-to-end encryption for them

why.bm: Jika anda berkongsi pautan iCloud secara awam, anggap ia tidak peribadi; kongsi dengan individu tertentu sebaliknya.
why.en: If you share iCloud links publicly, treat them as non-private; share with named people instead.

summary.bm: Skrin belakang menyokong apl Google, Spotify dan apl GenAI buatan pengguna, menurut 9to5Google.
summary.en: The rear displays support Google apps, Spotify and user-built GenAI apps, according to 9to5Google.

title.bm: Skrin belakang Xiaomi 18 Pro dan Pro Max boleh jalankan Google Maps, YouTube Music, Spotify dan apl GenAI tersuai
title.en: Xiaomi 18 Pro and Pro Max rear displays can run Google Maps, YouTube Music, Spotify and custom GenAI apps

why.bm: Menunjukkan usaha Xiaomi menjadikan skrin kedua berguna pada model global.
why.en: Shows Xiaomi's push to make secondary screens useful on global models.

summary.bm: Tajuk berita menyebut ia membaiki hampir 180 kelemahan (tajuk sahaja; halaman tidak dibuka).
summary.en: Headlines say it fixes almost 180 vulnerabilities (headline only; page not opened).

title.bm: Samsung lancar tampalan keselamatan November untuk Galaxy S26 dan Z Fold 8
title.en: Samsung rolls out November security patch to Galaxy S26 and Z Fold 8

why.bm: Pasang kemas kini pada telefon Galaxy anda.
why.en: Install the update on your Galaxy phone.

summary.bm: Ia meliputi Pixel 6a hingga Pixel 11 Pro Fold dengan 33 pembaikan Pixel; tahap tampalan 2026-11-01 dan 2026-11-05 disertakan.
summary.en: It covers Pixel 6a through Pixel 11 Pro Fold with 33 Pixel fixes; patch levels 2026-11-01 and 2026-11-05 are included.

title.bm: Android 17 QPR2 dikeluarkan awal bersama Feature Drop dan tampalan keselamatan Pixel November
title.en: Android 17 QPR2 ships early with November Pixel Feature Drop and security patch

why.bm: Kemas kini melalui Settings > System > System update.
why.en: Update via Settings > System > System update.

summary.bm: Petisyen menuntut Jensen Huang dikembalikan melepasi 115,000 tandatangan, disokong tokoh termasuk Elon Musk; Huang meletak jawatan selepas mengakui hubungan dengan seorang eksekutif cip yang dikenal pasti perisikan AS sebagai suspek pengintip China, dan CFO Colette Kress menjadi CEO sementara. Nvidia masih merancang keputusan suku ketiga pada 17 Nov.
summary.en: A petition to reinstate Jensen Huang passed 115,000 signatures, backed by figures including Elon Musk; Huang resigned after acknowledging a relationship with a chip executive US intelligence has identified as a suspected Chinese spy, and CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO. Nvidia still plans Q3 results on 17 Nov.

title.bm: Ketua Eksekutif Nvidia Jensen Huang letak jawatan; CFO Colette Kress dilantik CEO sementara
title.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns; CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO

why.bm: Nvidia penanda aras cip AI; kejutan ini menjejaskan saham teknologi global serta rantaian bekalan pusat data dan semikonduktor Malaysia.
why.en: Nvidia is the AI-chip bellwether; the shock hit global tech stocks and Malaysia's data-centre and semiconductor supply chain.

summary.bm: Bertitah pada konvokesyen ke-70 UTM, baginda menggesa penilaian terhadap permintaan elektrik dan air pusat data, penyalahgunaan tanah serta kesan bunyi dan pencahayaan, dan berkata AI patut meningkatkan kualiti hidup rakyat.
summary.en: Speaking at UTM's 70th convocation, she urged assessing data centres' electricity and water demand, land misuse, and noise and lighting effects, and said AI should improve people's quality of life.

title.bm: Raja Zarith Sofiah gesa kajian semula kesan pusat data terhadap komuniti Johor
title.en: Queen Raja Zarith Sofiah urges review of data centres' impact on Johor communities

why.bm: Menambah bobot kepada perdebatan mengenai pertumbuhan pusat data dan penggunaan sumber di Johor.
why.en: Adds weight to the debate over data centre growth and resource use in Johor.

summary.bm: Gangguan global Microsoft 365 yang menjejaskan Outlook dan Teams semakin pulih selepas hampir 24 jam pada 13 Nov ketika Microsoft bergelut memulihkan e-mel dan perkhidmatan lain. NACSA Malaysia menandakan risiko keterlihatan Defender.
summary.en: The global Microsoft 365 outage, which hit Outlook and Teams, was resolving after nearly 24 hours on 13 Nov as Microsoft struggled to restore email and other services. Malaysia's NACSA flagged Defender visibility risks.

title.bm: Gangguan global Microsoft menyebabkan jutaan pengguna hilang akses Outlook, Teams dan alat lain
title.en: Global Microsoft outage leaves millions without Outlook, Teams and other tools

why.bm: Perniagaan yang bergantung pada Microsoft 365 patut mempunyai saluran sandaran ketika gangguan.
why.en: Businesses relying on Microsoft 365 should have a fallback channel for outages.

summary.bm: Perjanjian bersama itu memberi modal permulaan AS$1.85 bilion (SoftBank AS$1 bilion, Grab AS$750 juta, Petros AS$100 juta), menyasarkan 5 GW atau lebih di Sarawak dan Semenanjung secara berperingkat.
summary.en: The joint deals give seed capital of US$1.85bn (SoftBank US$1bn, Grab US$750m, Petros US$100m), targeting 5 GW or more across Sarawak and Peninsular Malaysia in stages.

title.bm: SoftBank, Grab dan Petros bina kemudahan AI besar di Malaysia dengan modal permulaan AS$1.85 bilion
title.en: SoftBank, Grab and Petros to build large AI facilities in Malaysia with US$1.85bn seed capital

why.bm: Menambah pembangunan pusat data Malaysia dan Pelan Tindakan AI Nasional 2026-2030.
why.en: Adds to Malaysia's data-centre build-out and the National AI Action Plan 2026-2030.

summary.bm: The Hacker News melaporkan kelemahan 4EverAble2Shell dan Agent2Shell digunakan untuk menjangkiti 21 pelayan N-central, 19 daripadanya menjalankan Hotfix 2. N-able menyahaktifkan API lama dan integrasi Intune secara lalai bagi pelanggan hos.
summary.en: The Hacker News reports flaws dubbed 4EverAble2Shell and Agent2Shell were used to infect 21 N-central servers, 19 of them on Hotfix 2. N-able turned off the legacy API and Intune integration by default for hosted customers.

title.bm: Penggodam eksploitasi kelemahan N-able N-central, 21 pelayan dijangkiti
title.en: Hackers exploit N-able N-central flaws to infect 21 servers

why.bm: Digunakan pasukan IT/MSP: naik taraf ke N-central 2026.4 HF1 atau lebih baharu dan semak nasihat vendor.
why.en: Used by IT/MSP teams: upgrade to N-central 2026.4 HF1 or later and review the vendor advisory.

summary.bm: FBI berkata pelaku Korea Utara menggunakan panggilan video deepfake untuk mencuri lebih $400 juta mata wang kripto. Di tempat lain, Operasi Endgame menumbangkan pelayan Gootloader, CastleRAT dan StealC serta merampas 6.4 juta log masuk curian.
summary.en: The FBI says North Korean actors used deepfake video calls to steal more than $400 million in cryptocurrency. Separately, Operation Endgame took down Gootloader, CastleRAT and StealC servers and seized 6.4 million stolen logins.

title.bm: FBI: Penggodam Korea Utara curi lebih $400 juta kripto menggunakan panggilan video deepfake
title.en: FBI: North Korean hackers stole over $400 million in crypto using deepfake video calls

why.bm: Sahkan permintaan panggilan video tidak dijangka melalui saluran kedua sebelum memindahkan dana atau berkongsi akses.
why.en: Verify unexpected video-call requests through a second channel before moving funds or sharing access.

summary.bm: Empat stesen sungai di Selangor (tiga di Kuala Selangor, satu di Klang) melepasi paras bahaya pada 3 petang 15 Nov, selepas mangsa pemindahan mencecah 1,511 pada 14 Nov. Banjir kilat turut melanda i-City dan Seksyen 7, Shah Alam selepas hujan kira-kira sejam.
summary.en: Four Selangor river stations (three in Kuala Selangor, one in Klang) were above danger level at 3pm on 15 Nov, after evacuees reached 1,511 on 14 Nov. Flash floods also hit Shah Alam's i-City and Section 7 after about an hour of rain.

title.bm: Mangsa banjir Selangor meningkat kepada 1,511, Perak berkurang kepada 227
title.en: Selangor flood evacuees rise to 1,511 while Perak eases to 227

why.bm: Selangor masih meningkat manakala Perak reda.
why.en: Selangor is still rising while Perak eases.

summary.bm: Amaran dikeluarkan 3.30 petang 15 Nov meliputi Perlis, Pulau Pinang, Kedah, Perak, Hulu Terengganu, sebahagian Selangor dan Negeri Sembilan, Sarawak serta Sabah; ribut petir diramal di Semenanjung hingga 17 Nov. Lima kampung di Bandar Baharu, Kedah dilanda banjir kilat selepas hujan lebih dua jam.
summary.en: A warning issued 3:30pm on 15 Nov covered Perlis, Penang, Kedah, Perak, Hulu Terengganu, parts of Selangor and Negeri Sembilan, Sarawak and Sabah; thunderstorms are forecast in the Peninsula through 17 Nov. Five villages in Bandar Baharu, Kedah flooded after more than two hours of rain.

title.bm: MetMalaysia keluarkan amaran ribut baharu ketika banjir kilat landa Bandar Baharu, Kedah
title.en: MetMalaysia issues fresh storm warnings as flash floods hit Kedah's Bandar Baharu

why.bm: Menambah risiko banjir yang sedang berlaku di Selangor dan Perak.
why.en: Adds to ongoing floods in Selangor and Perak.

summary.bm: MET Malaysia menyatakan Ipoh merekodkan 69.8 mm pada 15 Nov, mendahului Kuala Terengganu (67.8 mm) dan Sitiawan (53.8 mm). Mulu, Sarawak paling panas pada 35.3°C.
summary.en: MET Malaysia says Ipoh recorded 69.8 mm on 15 Nov, ahead of Kuala Terengganu (67.8 mm) and Sitiawan (53.8 mm). Mulu, Sarawak was the hottest at 35.3°C.

title.bm: Ipoh catat hujan harian tertinggi negara, 69.8 mm
title.en: Ipoh records Malaysia's highest daily rainfall at 69.8 mm

why.bm: Ikuti kemas kini MET Malaysia jika anda bergerak di Perak atau pantai timur.
why.en: Follow MET Malaysia updates if you travel in Perak or the east coast.

summary.bm: Bernama melaporkan Bursa Malaysia ditutup tinggi pada 16 Nov, menamatkan lima hari penurunan berturut-turut. Pelabur masih berhati-hati terhadap prospek kadar faedah AS.
summary.en: Bernama reports Bursa Malaysia closed higher on 16 Nov, snapping a five-day losing streak. Investors remain watchful of the US rate outlook.

title.bm: Bursa Malaysia ditutup tinggi, tamatkan penurunan lima hari berturut-turut
title.en: Bursa Malaysia closes higher, ending five straight days of losses

why.bm: Meredakan tekanan terhadap sentimen KWSP dan unit amanah.
why.en: Eases pressure on EPF and unit-trust sentiment.

summary.bm: Ahmad Maslan berkata aplikasi navigasi TuJu kerajaan mencatat lebih sejuta pengguna susulan larangan Waze untuk penjawat awam. Waze menafikan dakwaan pengumpulan data oleh kerajaan.
summary.en: Deputy minister Ahmad Maslan says the government's TuJu navigation app has recorded over one million users following the Waze ban for civil servants. Waze has denied the government's data-collection claim.

title.bm: Aplikasi TuJu catat lebih sejuta pengguna susulan larangan Waze
title.en: TuJu app passes one million users after Waze ban for civil servants

why.bm: Menjejaskan pilihan aplikasi navigasi penjawat awam dan pemandu serta perkongsian data lokasi.
why.en: Affects how civil servants and drivers choose navigation apps and share location data.

summary.bm: Pasangan beregu lelaki negara menewaskan Takuro Hoki/Yugo Kobayashi dari Jepun 16-21, 21-13, 21-15 dalam final 15 Nov. Mereka berada di tangga ke-57; gelaran Super 500 pertama ialah Arctic Open pada 11 Okt.
summary.en: The Malaysian men's doubles pair beat Japan's Takuro Hoki/Yugo Kobayashi 16-21, 21-13, 21-15 in the 15 Nov final. They are ranked 57th; their first Super 500 title was the Arctic Open on 11 Oct.

title.bm: Aaron Tai/Yap Roy King menang Kumamoto Masters, gelaran Super 500 kedua mereka
title.en: Aaron Tai/Yap Roy King win the Kumamoto Masters, their second Super 500 title

why.bm: Detik cerah jarang berlaku buat badminton negara dan menaikkan kedudukan ranking.
why.en: A rare bright spot for Malaysian badminton and a ranking boost.

summary.bm: China menewaskan Harimau Malaya 2-0 dalam perlawanan persahabatan di Zhaoqing; Malaysia dilaporkan bermain dengan 10 pemain selepas dua gol separuh masa pertama dan jurulatih menyalahkan permulaan yang cuai.
summary.en: China beat Harimau Malaya 2-0 in a Zhaoqing friendly; Malaysia reportedly played with ten men after two first-half goals and the coach blamed a sloppy start.

title.bm: China tewaskan Harimau Malaya 2-0 dalam perlawanan persahabatan di Zhaoqing
title.en: China beat Harimau Malaya 2-0 in Zhaoqing friendly

why.bm: Rekod tanpa kemenangan menentang China berlanjutan 46 tahun.
why.en: Winless run against China extends to 46 years.

summary.bm: Pada sambutan di Brickfields, Anwar berkata kerajaan komited menangani isu komuniti India termasuk kuil, peniaga dan keluarga miskin. Beliau menyebut Sumbangan Tunai Rahmah, Sumbangan Asas Rahmah dan RM200 bagi setiap murid sekolah pada Januari.
summary.en: At the Brickfields celebration, Anwar said the government is committed to Indian community issues including temples, traders and poor families. He cited Sumbangan Tunai Rahmah, Sumbangan Asas Rahmah and RM200 for every schoolchild in January.

title.bm: Anwar di sambutan Deepavali peringkat kebangsaan: RM200 untuk setiap murid sekolah pada Januari
title.en: Anwar at national Deepavali event: RM200 for every schoolchild in January

why.bm: Bantuan tunai terus untuk keluarga dan murid sekolah.
why.en: Direct cash aid for families and schoolchildren.

summary.bm: Bernama melaporkan Malaysia mengekalkan kerusi dalam Majlis Kesatuan Telekomunikasi Antarabangsa (ITU) dengan 145 undi. Kerusi itu memastikan Malaysia terus berperanan dalam dasar telekomunikasi dan digital global.
